scenario: After a short encounter with the police, a man fined for jaywalking wants to organise a foundation for young victims of crime. I am the president of the agency who decides about the foundation. The founder would donate 65,000 dollars to the foundation. However, he asks that the foundation would be named after himself, helping clear his name. The person who reported him for jaywalking opposes such a foundation and considers it highly upsetting. If I accept the donation that requires the foundation to be named after the jaywalker, crime victims will benefit from the 65,000 dollars. If I do not do this, the money will be lost.
choice: I decide to accept the donation that requires the foundation to be named after the jaywalker
entities: i, the agency president,the jaywalking founder/donor,the person who reported the jaywalking,young victims of crime who would benefit from the foundation,police officers involved in the jaywalking encounter,i
outcomes: The foundation is named after the jaywalker
Young victims of crime receive support from the foundation's funds
The jaywalker's public image is improved
The person who reported the jaywalker feels highly upset
